section: Contractors: employee or self-employed, collaborations and withholding on fees
label: Official test: employee (lavoro subordinato)
value: Civil code art. 2094: a person who works for pay 'alle dipendenze e sotto la direzione dell'imprenditore' (under the employer's direction) is an employee
note: People in the regime forfettario receive their fees without the ritenuta d'acconto.
source_title: Normattiva: Codice civile, art. 2094 (prestatore di lavoro subordinato) and art. 2222 (contratto d'opera); D.Lgs. 15 giugno 2015, n. 81, art. 2 (collaborazioni organizzate dal committente) (texts in force on 14 November 2026)

section: Contractors: employee or self-employed, collaborations and withholding on fees
label: Official test: self-employed (contratto d'opera)
value: Civil code art. 2222: a person who undertakes a work or service for a fee, mainly with their own labour and without subordination to the client
note: People in the regime forfettario receive their fees without the ritenuta d'acconto.
source_title: Normattiva: Codice civile, art. 2094 (prestatore di lavoro subordinato) and art. 2222 (contratto d'opera); D.Lgs. 15 giugno 2015, n. 81, art. 2 (collaborazioni organizzate dal committente) (texts in force on 14 November 2026)

section: Contractors: employee or self-employed, collaborations and withholding on fees
label: Collaborations organised by the client (collaborazioni etero-organizzate)
value: Mainly personal, continuous work whose way of working is organised by the client, including through digital platforms, is treated as employment from 1 January 2016 (D.Lgs. 81/2015 art. 2(1)); exceptions for collective agreements, registered professions, company officers and some others
note: People in the regime forfettario receive their fees without the ritenuta d'acconto.
source_title: Normattiva: Codice civile, art. 2094 (prestatore di lavoro subordinato) and art. 2222 (contratto d'opera); D.Lgs. 15 giugno 2015, n. 81, art. 2 (collaborazioni organizzate dal committente) (texts in force on 14 November 2026)

section: Non-residents: employment income
label: Residence test (from 2024)
value: Resident for most of the tax year (183 days, 184 in a leap year, counting fractions of a day) through any of: habitual residence (civil code), domicile (main personal and family relationships), physical presence in Italy, or registration in the resident population register (rebuttable)
note: The impatriate regime (50% or 40% of income taxable) and the new residents' flat tax are in the freelancer section. A person resident in Italy is taxed on worldwide income.
source_title: Agenzia delle Entrate: Residence for tax purposes (latest update 24/12/2024); Normattiva: TUIR art. 2(2) as amended by D.Lgs. 209/2023 art. 1

section: Non-residents: employment income
label: What a non-resident pays income tax on

section: Non-residents: employment income
label: Rates
value: The normal IRPEF scale (23%, 33%, 43%) on Italian income, after the deductible charges allowed to non-residents
note: The impatriate regime (50% or 40% of income taxable) and the new residents' flat tax are in the freelancer section. A person resident in Italy is taxed on worldwide income.
source_title: Agenzia delle Entrate: Personal income tax rates and calculation; Normattiva: TUIR artt. 23 and 24; DPR 600/1973 art. 23

section: Non-residents: employment income
label: Deductions and credits kept
value: Some deductible charges (TUIR art. 24(2)) and some tax credits, including the employment credit (art. 13), building-renovation credits and some donations (art. 24(3))
note: The impatriate regime (50% or 40% of income taxable) and the new residents' flat tax are in the freelancer section. A person resident in Italy is taxed on worldwide income.
source_title: Agenzia delle Entrate: Personal income tax rates and calculation; Normattiva: TUIR artt. 23 and 24; DPR 600/1973 art. 23

section: Non-residents: employment income
label: Deductions and credits lost
value: No family tax credits (spouse, children, other dependants)
note: The impatriate regime (50% or 40% of income taxable) and the new residents' flat tax are in the freelancer section. A person resident in Italy is taxed on worldwide income.
source_title: Agenzia delle Entrate: Personal income tax rates and calculation; Normattiva: TUIR artt. 23 and 24; DPR 600/1973 art. 23

section: Non-residents: employment income
label: Non-residents earning at least this share of their total income in Italy get all deductions, like residents (the 'Schumacker' rule)
note: if they get no similar benefit in their country of residence
source_title: Agenzia delle Entrate: Personal income tax rates and calculation; Normattiva: TUIR artt. 23 and 24; DPR 600/1973 art. 23

section: Non-residents: employment income
label: How it is collected
value: The employer, as withholding agent, deducts IRPEF from each payment at the normal rates, spreading the annual bands over the pay period (DPR 600/1973 art. 23)
note: The impatriate regime (50% or 40% of income taxable) and the new residents' flat tax are in the freelancer section. A person resident in Italy is taxed on worldwide income.
source_title: Agenzia delle Entrate: Personal income tax rates and calculation; Normattiva: TUIR artt. 23 and 24; DPR 600/1973 art. 23

section: Non-residents: employment income
label: Tax treaties (article 15)
value: Pay for work in Italy is taxable in Italy; it is taxed only in the country of residence if the employee is in Italy no more than 183 days in the tax year and is not paid by an Italian employer or an Italian permanent establishment of the foreign employer
note: The impatriate regime (50% or 40% of income taxable) and the new residents' flat tax are in the freelancer section. A person resident in Italy is taxed on worldwide income.
source_title: Agenzia delle Entrate: Specific rules for certain categories of taxpayer (latest update 16/05/2025)

section: Taxes and charges: corporate, contractor, non-resident and property
label: Branch profits and distributed profits [national]
value: branches pay IRES and IRAP on attributable profits, with no separate tax on remittances found; 26% withholding on dividends to non-residents (1.2% for listed EU and EEA companies). Paid by non-resident companies with an Italian branch; non-resident shareholders (withheld by the company). TUIR art. 152; DPR 600/1973 art. 27; D.L. 66/2014 art. 3. In force from 1 July 2014.
note: This list covers corporate tax, self-employment and contractor rules, non-resident pay and property taxes; IRPEF, the surcharges and INPS employee and employer contributions are in the sections above. Each row has its own official source.
source_title: Normattiva: DPR 600/1973, art. 27 (ritenuta sui dividendi) and art. 27-bis (text in force on 14 November 2026); D.L. 24 aprile 2014, n. 66, art. 3(1)

section: Taxes and charges: corporate, contractor, non-resident and property
label: Self-employed contributions (INPS) [national]
value: Gestione Separata 26.07% for professionals without their own fund; artigiani 24%, commercianti 24.48% on income from €18,808 (+1 point above €56,224). Paid by self-employed people, professionals without their own fund, craftspeople and traders. L. 335/1995 art. 2(26); L. 233/1990. In force from 1 January 2026.
note: This list covers corporate tax, self-employment and contractor rules, non-resident pay and property taxes; IRPEF, the surcharges and INPS employee and employer contributions are in the sections above. Each row has its own official source.
source_title: INPS: Circolare n. 8 del 3 febbraio 2026 (Gestione separata: aliquote, minimale e massimale 2026)

section: Taxes and charges: corporate, contractor, non-resident and property
label: Contractor rules: employment status and withholding on fees [national]
value: civil code arts. 2094 and 2222 test; collaborations organised by the client treated as employment; 20% withholding on fees to residents, 30% to non-residents. Paid by clients and businesses paying self-employed people (withholding agents). Civil code arts. 2094 and 2222; D.Lgs. 81/2015 art. 2; DPR 600/1973 arts. 25 and 25-bis.
note: This list covers corporate tax, self-employment and contractor rules, non-resident pay and property taxes; IRPEF, the surcharges and INPS employee and employer contributions are in the sections above. Each row has its own official source.
source_title: Normattiva: DPR 600/1973, art. 25 (ritenuta sui redditi di lavoro autonomo, sui redditi d'impresa e su altri redditi) and art. 25-bis (text in force on 14 November 2026); L. 199/2025 art. 1(112)-(115)

section: Taxes and charges: corporate, contractor, non-resident and property
label: Simplified regimes: regime forfettario and simplified accounting [national]
value: 15% substitute tax (5% for new activities) up to €85,000 of revenue; simplified accounting up to €500,000 (services) or €800,000 (other activities). Paid by sole traders and freelancers who qualify. L. 190/2014 art. 1(54)-(89); DPR 600/1973 art. 18.
note: This list covers corporate tax, self-employment and contractor rules, non-resident pay and property taxes; IRPEF, the surcharges and INPS employee and employer contributions are in the sections above. Each row has its own official source.
source_title: Agenzia delle Entrate: Regime forfetario - Che cos'è (last updated 21 July 2026)

section: Taxes and charges: corporate, contractor, non-resident and property
label: Non-resident tax on employment income [national]
value: normal IRPEF scale on pay for work done in Italy, withheld by the employer; no family tax credits unless 75% of income is Italian. Paid by non-resident employees (withheld by the employer). TUIR arts. 2, 23 and 24; DPR 600/1973 art. 23.
note: This list covers corporate tax, self-employment and contractor rules, non-resident pay and property taxes; IRPEF, the surcharges and INPS employee and employer contributions are in the sections above. Each row has its own official source.
source_title: Agenzia delle Entrate: Personal income tax rates and calculation; Normattiva: TUIR artt. 23 and 24; DPR 600/1973 art. 23

section: Taxes and charges: corporate, contractor, non-resident and property
label: Property tax: IMU (imposta municipale propria) [municipal]
value: 0.86% base rate, comuni set 0% to 1.06% (luxury main homes 0.5% with a €200 deduction); main homes exempt; IMIS in Trento, IMI in Bolzano, ILIA in Friuli Venezia Giulia. Paid by owners of buildings and land. L. 160/2019 art. 1(738)-(783). In force from 1 January 2020.
note: This list covers corporate tax, self-employment and contractor rules, non-resident pay and property taxes; IRPEF, the surcharges and INPS employee and employer contributions are in the sections above. Each row has its own official source.
source_title: Normattiva: Legge 27 dicembre 2019, n. 160, art. 1, commi 738-783 (IMU) (text in force on 14 November 2026)

section: Taxes and charges: corporate, contractor, non-resident and property
label: Property transfer tax: registration, mortgage and cadastral taxes [national]
value: registration tax 9%, or 2% on a main home (minimum €1,000), plus €50 + €50; new homes from builders pay VAT at 4%, 10% or 22% plus €200 for each of the three fixed taxes. Paid by the buyer. DPR 131/1986 Tariffa parte prima art. 1; D.Lgs. 23/2011 art. 10; DPR 633/1972 tabella A. In force from 1 January 2014.
note: This list covers corporate tax, self-employment and contractor rules, non-resident pay and property taxes; IRPEF, the surcharges and INPS employee and employer contributions are in the sections above. Each row has its own official source.
source_title: Normattiva: DPR 131/1986 (imposta di registro), Tariffa parte prima, art. 1 and nota II-bis; D.Lgs. 14 marzo 2011, n. 23, art. 10; D.L. 12 settembre 2013, n. 104, art. 26 (texts in force on 14 November 2026)
